mapper.select: select count(1) from article_views where article_id = #{articleId}
select count(1) from article_favorites where article_id = #{articleId}
select count(1) from comments where article_id = #{articleId}
select created_at from articles where id = #{articleId}

select A.slug, A.title, A.description, count(AF.user_id) as favoriteCount from articles A inner join article_favorites AF on A.id = AF.article_id where A.created_at >= #{since} group by A.id order by favoriteCount desc limit 10
